turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We've got a week off in spring and want somewhere warm, but not a twelve hour flight.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lisbon, Seville or one of the Greek islands would all fit. Are you more in the mood for a city or a beach?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Excuse me for a moment, my friend has a question. Don't talk until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Have you seen my phone charger?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I think it's in the bedroom.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nina, which of these two prints should I put in the hallway?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The mountain one. The colors are amazing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You don't think the city one is better?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's good, but it's a bit dark for that wall.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: True, the hallway doesn't get much light. Mountain it is.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Put the city one in the bedroom maybe?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that took a while. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. You were deciding between a city trip and somewhere with a beach.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: City, definitely. I get bored lying on the sand.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then Lisbon is a great pick. Lots of walking, good food and day trips to the coast if you change your mind.
